name: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr vs. Baratza Encore ESP Pro
description: Comparison of distribution at similar median particle sizes. The Kinu produces significantly fewer fine particles, with a much tighter distribution.
chartTitle: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr  vs.  Baratza Encore ESP Pro
notes: This is just a demo dataset to show how the app works.

name: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr vs. Stock Burr
description: Comparing the Pour Over Burr (POB) and Stock Burr at similar median particle sizes on the Kinu M47 grinder. The POB produces significantly fewer fine particles, with a tighter distribution. Note that the POB requires 1-1.5 x fewer rotations for the same median particle size.
chartTitle: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr (2.0.0)  vs.  Stock Burr (3.5.0)
notes: This is another demo dataset to show how the app works.

name: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr vs. MHW-3BOMBER R3
description: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr compared to the MHW-3BOMBER R3, whose grinds are highly uniform (most particles are roughly the same size) without the wider distribution of the Kinu POB.
chartTitle: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr (3.0.0)   vs.  MHW-3BOMBER R3 (2+06)

name: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr - Settings 0.0.0 to 4.0.0
description: Kinu M47 grinder using the Pour Over Burr at five different settings. Worth noting that finer grind settings with the POB show a more even distribution of particle sizes, perhaps contributing to the contradictory levels of clarity/body reported at different ends of the spectrum.
chartTitle: Kinu M47 Pour Over Burr - Settings 0.0.0 to 4.0.0
notes: This is just a demo dataset to show how the app works.

name: Clump Remediation
description: Comparing results from an initial scatter, the same scatter with large clumps manually broken up, and with clump overlap separation enabled.

name: Dust & Boulders
description: Homogeneous samples of very fine particles as well as sifted boulders. Fines were the result of actively shaking off a previous sample but not *wiping* it off.
